cards.name: Mart Freshness
cards.description: Row count, last refresh time, and latest event time per mart. Rows turn red past 45 minutes stale, the same threshold the Datadog freshness monitor uses.

stages.native:
select mart, row_count, last_refreshed_at,
       round(extract(epoch from now() - last_refreshed_at) / 60, 1) as minutes_since_refresh,
       latest_event_at,
       round(extract(epoch from now() - latest_event_at) / 60, 1) as minutes_since_latest_event
from (
  select 'daily_store_sales' as mart, count(*) as row_count, max(updated_at) as last_refreshed_at, max(last_order_at) as latest_event_at from marts.daily_store_sales
  union all
  select 'hourly_order_volume', count(*), max(updated_at), max(order_hour) + interval '1 hour' from marts.hourly_order_volume
  union all
  select 'customer_value', count(*), max(updated_at), max(last_order_at) from marts.customer_value
) m
order by minutes_since_refresh desc

cards.name: Minutes Since Store Sales Refresh
cards.description: Minutes since marts.daily_store_sales was last rebuilt. Above 45 means the DAG has stalled or failed, for example under breaking_schema.

stages.native: select round(extract(epoch from now() - max(updated_at)) / 60, 1) as minutes_since_refresh from marts.daily_store_sales

cards.name: Stores with Negative Revenue
cards.description: Should always be 0. Anything above 0 means refund handling is broken in the store sales mart (refund_bug).

cards.name: Total Orders per Hour
cards.description: All-store order volume per hour. A drop to zero or a missing hour means the stream or the DAG stopped.

visualization_settings.text:
**What to watch**

- **Freshness** goes red past 45 min when the DAG stalls or fails (`breaking_schema`).
- **Negative revenue** goes above 0 when refunds are miscounted (`refund_bug`, Denver).
- **Orders per hour** flattening means the order stream stopped.
